Kormir has told you all you need to know about interaction and fighting, so it's time to prove your knowledge. First Spear Jahdugar will prepare you for your first mission.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
 |campaign = Nightfall
}}

===Objectives===
*Speak with [[First Spear Jahdugar]].
*See First Spear Jahdugar for your reward.

===Reward===
* [[Koss]] joins your party.

==Walkthrough==
Walk to [[First Spear Jahdugar]] and speak with him. Choose to enter. That's it.

==Dialogue== 
===Initial dialogue===
;Kormir
:''We have prepared you recruits for battle, so let's drive these corsairs into the sea. Speak to [[First Spear Jahdugar]] when you are ready to enter the village.''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I am ready.
|decline = I have more preparations to make.
|ask = When asked about quest:''' ''Speak to [[First Spear Jahdugar]] and he will let you into Chahbek Village. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;First Spear Jahdugar
:''Thank the gods you've arrived! The corsair vanguard is overwhelming our defenses.''
::{{yes|ingame}}'''Let me know when you are ready.'''
::''Let me know when you are ready!''
:::{{yes|ingame}}'''We are ready.''' (sent to [[Chahbek Village (cinematics)#Cinematic 1|Chahbek Village (cinematics)]])
:::{{no|ingame}}'''We are not ready yet.'''

===Reward dialogue===
;First Spear Jahdugar
:''It is good to meet you, [Character Name]. Kormir has spoken very highly of you and Koss.''

== Notes ==
* [[Resign]]ing after accepting this quest will cause you to move to the outpost even if you haven't talked to First Spear Jahdugar.
